Select a unit. Capture villages. Defeat the red commander.

Settings

Field manual

Each unit moves once and attacks once. Attacking ends its turn.

Capture a village by entering it. Each owned village earns 2 gold at the start of your turn and heals a friendly occupant by 2 HP.

Select an enemy, then tap a weapon to attack. Use the magnifying glass for damage details. Each unit attacks once per turn. A surviving defender replies once with its strongest weapon of the same kind: melee answers melee; ranged answers ranged. Both weapons must reach. Forests and hills block ranged shots through them.

Blade, Pierce, and Impact damage interact with armor. Soldiers receive 75% of Blade and Pierce base damage, and 125% of Impact base damage. Commanders receive 75% of Blade base damage. Archers and scouts receive 100%. Damage is rounded to the nearest whole number after resistance, then terrain cover and shallow-water exposure apply. Every hit deals at least 1 damage. The combat preview shows the exact outcome; there are no hit-chance rolls.

Forests cost 2 movement and reduce ranged damage by 1. Hills cost 2 movement and reduce all damage by 1. Scouts spend only 1 movement in forests and hills. Water is impassable; bridges cost 1 movement. Shallow water costs 3 for soldiers and commanders, 2 for archers and scouts, and adds 1 to damage received.

Keep your commander on your keep, then select an adjacent empty land hex and choose a recruit. The unit appears on that hex and acts next turn.

Defeat the enemy commander to win. Keyboard: Tab to the map, use arrow keys to browse hexes, Enter to select. Escape clears selection.
